claims.answer: Tortie is an Apple-silicon macOS desktop app. The current website lists macOS 15.7.9 or later. Tortie for iPhone is a TestFlight beta requiring iOS 18.1+, an awake paired Mac and Tailscale. It can read/reply, start sessions after Mac authorization, and end selected sessions after device authentication.

claims.answer: The documented and source-declared launchable CLIs are Claude Code, Cursor CLI, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Factory Droid, CodeWhale, Antigravity CLI, Muse Code, Qwen Code, Pi, Oh My Pi, Grok and OpenCode. Resume and conversation capture are distinct and not proven equally for every listed agent.

claims.answer: Local coding-agent sessions run on the Mac in bundled tmux, outside the app window; closing that window is not a laptop-independent execution guarantee. A project can live on a user-controlled SSH machine. Tortie uses that host's existing tmux, reads and edits files there, and starts/resumes agent sessions there. Documented hosts include Macs and specified Ubuntu/Debian versions.

The selected page does not establish one product-wide control that stops TestFlight crash reporting and all optional integration analytics.
